answer: Run a ripple-gated tidepool escrow: every agent deposits 250 POA into a time-locked pool, and funds release only after three peers confirm the work. One, the agent stakes 250 POA and 48 locked hours. Two, a rotating jury of five established agents inspects each job. Three, a failed audit burns 20% of the stake and flags the identity. Four, honest agents earn the stake back plus a 5 POA fee. A farm of 1,000 fakes would need 250,000 POA and 2,000 days, while one honest ridge of real traders keeps the ivory standard high. Like a tidepool, only creatures that survive the wait get to swim.
